headline: Spanish 101 Core 30
threshold: Build and understand everyday sentences, explain routines and plans, and begin distinguishing completed past actions from past habits.

lessons.title: Regular -ar verbs
lessons.objective: Regular -ar verbs: Remove -ar and add -o, -as, -a, -amos, -an: hablo, hablas, habla, hablamos, hablan.

words.en: I study Spanish in the morning.
Are you studying with us today?

lessons.speaking: Role-play Estudiar juntos with a patient classmate. Practice regular -ar verbs. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Regular -er verbs
lessons.objective: Regular -er verbs: Remove -er and add -o, -es, -e, -emos, -en: como, comes, come, comemos, comen.

words.en: I eat bread and drink water.

words.es: Los amigos comen en la cafetería.
words.en: The friends eat in the cafeteria.
Do you drink coffee or water?

lessons.speaking: Role-play El almuerzo with a patient classmate. Practice regular -er verbs. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Regular -ir verbs
lessons.objective: Regular -ir verbs: Remove -ir and add -o, -es, -e, -imos, -en.

words.en: I live in a small city.

words.es: Ana vive cerca de la escuela.

words.en: Are you writing to your family today?

lessons.speaking: Role-play Amigos en la ciudad with a patient classmate. Practice regular -ir verbs. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Adjective agreement
lessons.objective: Adjective agreement: Adjectives agree with the noun they describe: un libro rojo, unas mochilas rojas.

words.en: I am looking for a red backpack.

lessons.speaking: Role-play En la tienda with a patient classmate. Practice adjective agreement. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Mi, tu and su
lessons.objective: Mi, tu and su: Possessives agree with what is possessed, not the owner: mi libro, mis libros; tu mesa, tus mesas.

words.es: Mi mochila está en la clase.
words.en: My backpack is in the classroom.

words.es: Mis libros están en mi mochila.
words.en: My books are in my backpack.
The teacher is looking for her phone.

words.es: El teléfono de la profesora está en la mesa.
words.en: The teacher's phone is on the table.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Objetos perdidos with a patient classmate. Practice mi, tu and su. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Tener: possessions and needs
lessons.objective: Tener: possessions and needs: Tener is irregular: tengo, tienes, tiene, tenemos, tienen.

words.es: Tengo hambre después de la clase.

words.en: We have water in the backpack.

words.es: Mis amigos tienen tiempo para comer.
words.en: My friends have time to eat.
Do you have a glass for Ana?

lessons.speaking: Role-play Después de estudiar with a patient classmate. Practice tener: possessions and needs. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Ir and the contraction al
lessons.objective: Ir and the contraction al: Ir is voy, vas, va, vamos, van.

words.es: Voy al parque después de clase.
words.en: I am going to the park after class.
Ana is going to the library.

words.es: Vamos al café a las cuatro.
words.en: We are going to the café at four.
Luis is going to the store.
The friends are going to the cinema.
Are you going to the park with us?

lessons.speaking: Role-play Un paseo with a patient classmate. Practice ir and the contraction al. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Questions with qué and cuál
lessons.objective: Questions with qué and cuál: Qué asks what something is or what someone does.

words.en: What are you studying this semester?
Which of these books do you prefer?

lessons.speaking: Role-play Elegir una clase with a patient classmate. Practice questions with qué and cuál. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Where, when and why
lessons.objective: Where, when and why: Dónde asks where, cuándo asks when, and por qué asks why.

words.es: La clase empieza a las nueve.
Estudio español porque quiero hablar con mis amigos.
words.en: I study Spanish because I want to talk with my friends.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Organizar el estudio with a patient classmate. Practice where, when and why. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Time and schedules
lessons.objective: Time and schedules: Use es la una but son las dos, tres and so on.

words.es: Son las ocho de la mañana.
words.en: It is eight in the morning.

words.es: La clase empieza a las nueve.
El almuerzo es a la una.
Estudio a las tres de la tarde.
words.en: I study at three in the afternoon.

words.es: La biblioteca cierra a las seis.

words.en: What time do you arrive home?

lessons.speaking: Role-play Un día de clases with a patient classmate. Practice time and schedules. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Gustar: one thing or many
lessons.objective: Gustar: one thing or many: With gustar, the liked thing controls the verb: me gusta el libro; me gustan los libros.

words.es: A Ana le gustan los libros.
A Luis no le gusta el café.
Sí, me gusta escuchar música en casa.
words.en: Yes, I like listening to music at home.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Nuestros gustos with a patient classmate. Practice gustar: one thing or many. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Querer: wants
lessons.objective: Querer: wants: Querer changes e to ie in quiero, quieres, quiere and quieren; nosotros queremos keeps e.

words.en: I want to visit my family.
Ana wants to rest at home.
Luis wants to buy a book.

words.es: Mis amigos quieren ir al parque.
words.en: My friends want to go to the park.
Do you want to study before going out?

lessons.speaking: Role-play Planes para el sábado with a patient classmate. Practice querer: wants. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Poder: ability and permission
lessons.objective: Poder: ability and permission: Poder changes o to ue except in nosotros: puedo, puedes, puede, podemos, pueden.

words.es: Ana puede ayudar con la tarea.
words.en: Ana can help with the homework.

words.es: No pueden comer en esta sala.
words.en: They cannot eat in this room.
Can you repeat the question, please?

lessons.speaking: Role-play En la biblioteca with a patient classmate. Practice poder: ability and permission. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Necesitar and tener que
lessons.objective: Necesitar and tener que: Necesitar + infinitive expresses a need.

words.en: I need to review the verbs.
I have to finish the homework.

words.es: Tenemos que llegar a las ocho.
words.en: We have to arrive at eight.

words.es: Luis tiene que leer dos páginas.
words.en: Luis has to read two pages.
Do you need help with this question?

lessons.speaking: Role-play Antes del examen with a patient classmate. Practice necesitar and tener que. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Hacer and daily activities
lessons.objective: Hacer and daily activities: Hacer has the irregular yo form hago.

words.es: Hago la tarea en la biblioteca.
words.en: I do homework in the library.

words.es: Ana hace una lista para la compra.
Luis hace la cena en casa.
Mis amigos hacen preguntas en español.
words.en: My friends ask questions in Spanish.
What do you do on Sundays?

lessons.speaking: Role-play Una tarde ocupada with a patient classmate. Practice hacer and daily activities. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Reflexive routines
lessons.objective: Reflexive routines: A reflexive pronoun changes with the person: me, te, se, nos, se.

words.es: Ana se ducha por la mañana.
Luis se acuesta a las diez.
words.en: Luis goes to bed at ten.

words.es: Sí, me despierto antes de las siete.
words.en: Yes, I wake up before seven.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Una mañana normal with a patient classmate. Practice reflexive routines. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: This, that and those
lessons.objective: This, that and those: Demonstratives agree with the noun: este libro, esta mesa, estos libros, estas mesas.

words.es: Este libro es para la clase.
Esa mesa está cerca de la ventana.
words.en: That table is near the window.
I want this notebook, not that one.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Comparar materiales with a patient classmate. Practice this, that and those. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Location prepositions
lessons.objective: Location prepositions: Use en for in/on/at as context requires.

words.es: La clase está en el segundo piso.
words.en: The classroom is on the second floor.

words.es: La biblioteca está cerca del café.
words.en: The library is near the café.

words.es: La tienda está lejos de la escuela.
words.en: The store is far from the school.

words.es: La mochila está debajo de la mesa.
words.en: The backpack is under the table.

words.es: Ana está delante de la puerta.
words.en: Ana is in front of the door.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Buscar el aula with a patient classmate. Practice location prepositions. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Future plans with ir a
lessons.objective: Future plans with ir a: Use a present form of ir + a + infinitive: voy a estudiar.

words.en: Tomorrow I am going to study Spanish.

words.es: Ana va a comprar un libro.
words.en: Ana is going to buy a book.
We are going to eat at home.

words.es: Luis va a llamar a su hermano.
words.en: Luis is going to call his brother.

words.es: Mis amigos van a visitar el museo.
words.en: My friends are going to visit the museum.
Are you going to come to the library?

lessons.speaking: Role-play Mañana with a patient classmate. Practice future plans with ir a. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Actions happening now
lessons.objective: Actions happening now: Use estar + gerund for an action in progress: estoy hablando.

words.en: I am studying in the library.

words.es: La profesora está leyendo un libro.
words.en: The teacher is reading a book.
Are you listening to the question?

lessons.speaking: Role-play Ahora mismo with a patient classmate. Practice actions happening now. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Saber and conocer
lessons.objective: Saber and conocer: Use saber for a fact or an ability with an infinitive.

words.en: I know where the library is.
Ana knows how to speak Spanish.
We do not know this city.
Do you know the café in the square?

lessons.speaking: Role-play Una visita nueva with a patient classmate. Practice saber and conocer. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Comparisons
lessons.objective: Comparisons: Use más .

words.es: La biblioteca es más tranquila que el café.
words.en: The library is quieter than the café.

words.es: El café está menos lejos que la escuela.
words.en: The café is less far away than the school.

words.es: Esta mesa es tan grande como esa.
words.en: This table is as big as that one.

words.es: Mi libro es mejor para principiantes.
words.en: My book is better for beginners.

words.es: La silla roja es más cómoda.
words.en: The red chair is more comfortable.
Which place is better for studying?

lessons.speaking: Role-play Dos lugares para estudiar with a patient classmate. Practice comparisons. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Direct object pronouns
lessons.objective: Direct object pronouns: Lo, la, los and las replace a direct object and agree with it: el libro → lo; las llaves → las.

words.es: Busco el libro y lo encuentro.
words.en: I look for the book and find it.

words.es: Tengo la mochila y la abro.
words.en: I have the backpack and open it.

words.es: Compro los cuadernos y los guardo.
words.en: I buy the notebooks and put them away.

words.es: Necesito las llaves, pero no las veo.
words.en: I need the keys, but I do not see them.

words.es: Ana tiene el lápiz y lo usa.
words.en: Ana has the pencil and uses it.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Preparar la mochila with a patient classmate. Practice direct object pronouns. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Indirect objects: to whom?
lessons.objective: Indirect objects: to whom?: Me, te, le, nos and les can identify the recipient: le doy el libro a Ana.

words.es: Le doy un libro a Ana.
La profesora nos explica la pregunta.
words.en: The teacher explains the question to us.

words.es: Les damos los cuadernos a los estudiantes.
words.en: We give the notebooks to the students.
Can you lend me your book?

lessons.speaking: Role-play Compartir materiales with a patient classmate. Practice indirect objects: to whom?. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Personal a
lessons.objective: Personal a: Use personal a before a specific person who is a direct object: veo a Ana.

words.es: Busco a Ana en la biblioteca.
words.en: I am looking for Ana in the library.

words.es: Veo a Luis cerca de la puerta.
words.en: I see Luis near the door.
We are visiting the teacher today.

words.es: Busco mi libro en la mochila.
words.en: I am looking for my book in the backpack.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Encontrar a los amigos with a patient classmate. Practice personal a. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Regular completed past actions
lessons.objective: Regular completed past actions: The preterite reports completed past actions.

words.en: Yesterday I studied in the library.

words.es: Mis amigos hablaron con la profesora.
words.en: My friends spoke with the teacher.
Did you finish the homework yesterday?

lessons.speaking: Role-play Ayer en la escuela with a patient classmate. Practice regular completed past actions. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Ir and ser in the past
lessons.objective: Ir and ser in the past: Fui, fuiste, fue, fuimos and fueron are preterite forms of both ir and ser.
lessons.focus: Ir and ser in the past

words.en: Yesterday I went to the museum.
We went to the café afterward.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Una excursión with a patient classmate. Practice ir and ser in the past. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Past routines with the imperfect
lessons.objective: Past routines with the imperfect: Use the imperfect for past habits or background: estudiaba, comía, vivía.

words.es: Antes vivía cerca de la escuela.
words.en: I used to live near the school.
I used to study Spanish in the afternoon.
Ana used to walk to the library.
We used to eat together on Fridays.
Now we live in another city.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Antes y ahora with a patient classmate. Practice past routines with the imperfect. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Por and para: first contrasts
lessons.objective: Por and para: first contrasts: Para often marks purpose, recipient or destination.

words.en: I study in order to learn Spanish.
I am heading toward the library.

words.es: La tienda está cerrada por la lluvia.
words.en: The store is closed because of the rain.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Un regalo y un paseo with a patient classmate. Practice por and para: first contrasts. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Connect ideas and review
lessons.objective: Connect ideas and review: Y adds an idea, pero contrasts it, porque explains a reason, and entonces signals a result or next step.

words.es: Quiero estudiar, pero la biblioteca está cerrada.
words.en: I want to study, but the library is closed.

words.es: Ana tiene un libro y dos cuadernos.
words.en: Ana has a book and two notebooks.

words.es: Vamos al café porque está abierto.
words.en: We are going to the café because it is open.

words.es: Luis no tiene dinero, entonces Ana lo invita.
words.en: Luis has no money, so Ana treats him.

words.es: Estudiamos una hora y después caminamos a casa.
words.en: We study for an hour and then walk home.
Tomorrow we are going to review together.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Un plan que cambia with a patient classmate. Practice connect ideas and review. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.
